column1: # Negative-path login attempts — none of these require a real seeded account
# so this file runs safely with no environment setup.
# Note: the form uses native HTML5 `required` on both fields
# cases are asserted as "browser blocks submission"
# field error (see native-required.spec.js). Any non-existent phone number
# gets an "account not found" error from the backend regardless of password.
